property.name: zeppelin.notebook.cron.folders
property.description: Comma separated list of folders that can use cron. * means all folders.

property.name: zeppelin.notebook.cache.threshold
property.description: Maximum number of notebooks kept in memory. Increase this to avoid 'Can not evict note' warnings.

property.name: zeppelin.rest.interpreter.enable
property.description: Allow REST API to create/update/delete interpreter settings

property.name: zeppelin.server.allowed.origins
property.description: Allowed sources for REST and WebSocket requests (i.e. http://onehost:8080,http://otherhost.com). If you leave * you are vulnerable to https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/ZEPPELIN-173

property.name: zeppelin.interpreter.mode
property.description: Interpreter mode: shared | scoped | isolated WAS ISLOLATED

property.name: zeppelin.interpreter.lifecyclemanager.timeout.threshold
property.description: The idle timeout limit, in milliseconds.

property.name: zeppelin.server.html.body.addon
property.value:
<script>
(function () {
  var base = location.protocol + "//" + location.hostname + ":8086";
  window.ZM_CONFIG = {
    catalogUrl: base + "/metastore-catalog.json",
    refreshMinutes: 30,
    railPosition: "center"
  };
  var s = document.createElement("script");
  s.defer = true;
  s.src = base + "/zeppelin-metastore.js";
  document.body.appendChild(s);
})();
</script>
property.description: Боковая панель метаданных: грузит скрипт и каталог с metastore-web. Внутри CDATA только ASCII
